notes.title: Urgent update on serious issues
notes.content:
First of all, I'm very sorry, in one of my error modification caused, keyboard users can not close the keyboard prompt.
I didn't find it in time, now it has been fixed urgently Fix version 1.0.7.10 Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Minor updates
notes.content:
Added content.
Russian Japanese French
Modified platinum conditions (now changed to kill the final boss)
Modified combat planes Damage to large sea monsters

notes.title: Official version released
notes.content:
After a long time the official version is finally released
Bug fixes
olist]
Time timer can not be extended correctly after completing the silver mission
Final boss appearance exception
Laser gun shows extra arm
[/olist]
New content
[olist]
New Traditional Chinese
Added Xbox 360/Xbox One controller control
[/olist]

Written at the end
I will continue to monitor the game and feedback from players to improve the game content and add new content as appropriate.

notes.title: The last update before the official release
notes.content:
bug fix:
[olist]
Fix the indication that the plane cannot be carried out after archiving
Fix the problem that monsters cannot be killed occasionally
Fix the problem that appears after refueling the aircraft
Fix the problem that the ladder does not work after archiving
Optimized some controls, now stop won't move forward
[/olist]
New features:
[olist]
Added new underground module
Added final boss
New diving suit
Added laser gun
Added new island
Updated achievement system
Added diving system
I've hidden the key to the lighthouse somewhere, please be patient and look for it.
New mission hints and keyboard hints, cancelled the previous hints interface
[/olist]

notes.title: Major Updates Bugs & Content
notes.content:
Feature Updates
[olist]
 Updating the achievement system
 Updating the island and the boat
 Update guns (laser gun can call for air support)
 Weakening the durability of sea monsters
Advance the game success time
[/olist]
Bug
[olist]
Fix bug where monsters with access to doors would lose their crash fall if they entered the door
Change in attack mode now allows any weapon to be fired in bursts with a long press.
[/olist]
We are currently working on the 3rd boss, and will release a final test version soon.

 Optimizing the issue of going up and down ladders

notes.title: New content has been updated & bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes
[olist]
Fixed that clicking pause would stop the game but not the music (now the music will stop when you click pause)
Fix the death animation that would play again if a monster was killed multiple times in quick succession
Fix for clicking on pause when the resolution exceeds the actual resolution and then getting stuck
[/olist]
Update
[olist]
Update Sea Monster (now that the fourth monster has appeared, be prepared before night falls)
 Update some of the music
[/olist]

notes.title: The bunker has been updated.
notes.content:

1. update the bunker (now you can go down into the bunker)
2. Modernization of lifts
3. Increase the flame thrower
4. Increase in combat aircraft
5. Additional street lights
Bug fixes

Description
